description: This file defines a React component 'DesktopLayout' for rendering a complex, resizable code challenge interface with multiple panes, including instructions, editor, notes, preview, and console. It manages layout state, interactions, and Redux connections.

classes.name: DesktopLayout
classes.description: A React component that renders a multi-pane challenge interface with instructions, code editor, notes, preview, and console, with layout state management and Redux integration.

methods.name: initialShowState
methods.description: Retrieves and parses layout pane visibility state from local storage.

methods.name: togglePane
methods.description: Toggles visibility of different layout panes such as preview, notes, console, and instructions.
